name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Implementation & Onboarding Specialist | CRM Data & Cross-Functional Coordination
summary: Customer onboarding and implementation professional with 15+ years across SaaS, agency, and B2B environments. Personally onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month while building and maintaining CRM data structures in Salesforce and HubSpot. Builds sequenced implementation plans that keep multi-stakeholder projects on track and on deadline, and brings direct healthcare-vertical B2B experience.

Architect and manage CRM systems in GoHighLevel and HubSpot, including contact segmentation and data-hygiene protocols, documenting every client interaction and deliverable.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Led onboarding and training for a diverse, high-volume partner network in Salesforce.
Sold channel partnerships to agencies focused on healthcare clients, a meaningful share of the partner book, developing direct B2B healthcare-vertical experience.
Guided customers through complex technical setup and configuration of reputation and marketing-automation tools, developing scalable communication workflows that reduced onboarding friction.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets, while maintaining accurate CRM records for a high-value account portfolio.
Labeled and defined the CRM fields required for outbound sales and onboarding workflows, building client profiles and standardizing data capture across a team of onboarding specialists.
Led onboarding and launch operations as team lead, delivering launches on time and accelerating time-to-value.

bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and handed them to the implementation team to execute against.
Guided onboarding alongside implementation teams, troubleshooting workflow design and resolving technical challenges during setup.
